verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only a first-party 'B2B Recipe' page title and a GitHub claim that the framework and modules 'can be used to support advanced B2B' stores. That is developer building-block language, not a documented native capability. Nothing in the pack shows customer-specific price lists, volume pricing, quotes or net-terms invoicing running alongside DTC.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell B2B and wholesale — customer-specific price lists, volume pricing, quotes or net-terms invoicing — alongside DTC
